description.value: Katana is a Japanese Steak and Seafood House in Langley specializing in teppan yaki, where master chefs cook Triple-A steaks and fresh seafood directly at tableside grills. The interactive dining experience features premium cuts alongside lobster tails, giant shrimp, and king scallops in a casual, lively atmosphere. It is a well-established local hotspot with an extensive international wine list.
